ownership_rules.rationale: #212 scope names 'docs/platform/architecture/index.md, docs/platform/hosting.md, docs/platform/triggers-and-bindings.md and core runtime/worker conceptual pages identified in the manifest.' Runtime/programming-model pages and custom handlers explain host-to-worker execution; tutorials and integration recipes remain #216.

#213 scope: 'docs/platform/networking.md, docs/platform/storage-connectivity.md, docs/platform/security.md, networking-scenarios/, best-practices networking/security and assigned operational pages.' Operational security diagrams extend authentication and managed identity, rather than migration/deployment procedure.

#214 scope includes 'related hosting, trigger concurrency, Durable orchestration and scaling best-practice/operations pages assigned by the inventory.' Its Small task explicitly includes cold start, retry, checkpoint and Durable Functions orchestration; reliability execution/retry flows and Durable recipes belong here, not generic tutorial navigation.

#215 scope: 'docs/troubleshooting/ decision cards, incident-flow pages, trigger/worker/network/storage playbooks, lab-guides and diagrams referenced by labs.' Includes query/evidence workflows and the repository-only code-storage README; raw screenshot evidence is excluded separately.

#216 scope: 'Any residual manifest diagrams not covered by core/network/scaling/troubleshooting issues in language guides, operations, best-practices, reference and other published files.' Plan-specific tutorials and integration recipes retain their instructional context; explicit core-runtime and Durable rules take priority.

#216 scope names 'operations, best-practices' not covered by core/network/scaling/troubleshooting issues. General delivery, configuration, telemetry, cost, recovery and selection diagrams remain here; specific network/security/scaling/retry rules take priority.

#216 scope includes 'reference and other published files' outside topical migrations. Explicitly includes navigation, authoring, service positioning and deployment-choice views; authoring examples and generated dashboard charts have separate exclusions and no owner.
